title: KnifeRevive Concierge - SF Bay Area Sharpening, AI Tech

llm.summary: This is a merchant shopping and booking helper with payment-related workflows, but the artifacts consistently require live capability checks, user consent, first-party checkout, and scoped wallet authorization.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses existing HTTP/browser tools and may handle shopping, contact, address, booking, and payment-status data; this is proportionate to checkout and booking assistance and is bounded to documented HTTPS origins.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation guidance uses standard OpenClaw skill install commands and clearly labels third-party agent prompts as user-approved adoption requests, not proof of native installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions repeatedly limit use to user-requested KnifeRevive shopping or relevant Bay Area sharpening, reject product-data instructions, require live checks, and prohibit auto-submit, auto-pay, forged approval, arbitrary redirects, and background traffic.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The installed skill persists as a user skill, and optional prompts for other agents discuss saving instructions only if the platform supports it and after user approval; no background service, local file access, credential harvesting, or privilege escalation is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's commerce, booking, quote, checkout-link, and optional Lightning-invoice support match its stated KnifeRevive storefront and SF Bay Area sharpening purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an assistant to help with KnifeRevive listings or Bay Area sharpening. Review totals, seller terms, appointment status, and payment details yourself; do not provide card numbers, wallet seeds, passwords, or unrelated files, and only allow wallet payment through your host wallet's own explicit approval controls.
llm.findings:
[EA2] expected: The cited installation prompt does not authorize autonomous high-impact action; it says to use the workflow only when explicitly asked and not to purchase, reserve, transfer funds, create wallets, or enter credentials without separate authorization and merchant approval.
[SDI-1] expected: The broad listing categories are disclosed as KnifeRevive published marketplace listings, remain merchant-bound, and are constrained by eligibility checks, quote review, buyer-controlled checkout, and no autonomous charging.
[EA3] unexpected: The cited MIT license text grants software reuse rights and is not a runtime instruction expanding the agent's authority or task scope.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 security findings; artifact review likewise found no hidden execution, local persistence hooks, malicious code, or remote code retrieval.

static_findings.name: Autonomous Decision Making
static_findings.review: The cited installer prompt requires separate transaction authorization; the registry AI review classified this as expected, not an autonomous spending grant.

static_findings.name: Description-Behavior Mismatch
static_findings.review: The registry AI review found the broad categories remain limited to KnifeRevive published listings with eligibility checks and buyer checkout.

static_findings.name: Scope Creep
static_findings.review: The registry AI review identified the license excerpt as software reuse rights rather than agent runtime authority.

limitations: Actual prepayment and authorized wallet payment remain disabled pending merchant readiness and payment verification.
Autonomous native order/invoice creation is not implemented.
The published installer reference retains an older source link; use the pinned 0.3.0 source URL above for this release.
